findings.claim: The malformed-shape parametrization never exercises two reject branches in from_mapping. One is a non-dict `provenance` (e.g. None), which hits the 'invalid owned laboratory run provenance' branch. The other is a non-dict `definition` (e.g. None or a list) at the snapshot level. A removal of the `type(provenance) is not dict` guard would raise TypeError at `set(provenance)` instead of ValueError, and the test's `(TypeError, ValueError)` tolerance would still pass. Behavior is correct as written; only the proof is thin.

Read in full: current laboratory_run_snapshots.py (79 lines) and test_laboratory_run_snapshots.py (178 lines). Also read the full laboratories.py (LaboratoryConfig and LaboratoryDefinition: __post_init__, to_mapping, strict from_mapping, create_laboratory_definition, initial_laboratory_definitions), the full reference_labs.py, the legacy reference_lab_store._validate_input provenance/config contract, conftest.py, and the head of test_laboratory_definitions.py for import conventions.

Source analysis against the criteria. The root is exactly {schema_version:1, kind:'owned_laboratory_run', definition, provenance}. Provenance is exactly {history_sha256, rankings_sha256, history_origin:'frozen'}. It is distinct from the legacy {schema_version, config, provenance} shape, which has no `kind`/`definition`, so the legacy shape and any extra or missing key are rejected by the exact key-set check. Version and kind are checked with `type(...) is int/str` plus equality, so bool, float and subclasses are rejected. Digests use `type is str` plus `fullmatch` on [0-9a-f]{64}, so uppercase, whitespace and trailing newlines are rejected. The constructor guards `type(definition) is LaboratoryDefinition` before any to_mapping call. The decoder delegates to LaboratoryDefinition.from_mapping with no duplicated validation, which preserves UUID/seed reference_id/name/config/finance/window checks. The dataclass is frozen with slots, and to_mapping builds fresh nested dicts and lists on each call (definition.to_mapping() copies config and prizes), so there is no aliasing. The module imports only re and dataclasses plus laboratories.LaboratoryDefinition: no storage, engine, service or API imports and no I/O. Equal history/rankings digests are allowed, and the test documents that. The SQL schema and legacy codecs are untouched, since the diff adds only the two files.

Test coverage in the added file: manual and seed round trips; all 14 seeds checked as DTO round trips with no engine; alias and frozen mutation; custom flat finance/window round trip; 20 malformed cases (version bool/float/2, kind wrong/int, extra and missing keys, legacy config key, provenance extra/missing/origin live/int, digest case/length/non-hex/int, nested definition version bool, padded name, config bool capital, non-canonical window); non-mapping and legacy shape; exact-type constructor with a forged subclass; non-canonical pins; equal pins. No functional defect was found.
